meta.title: Follow the Light
meta.description: Memorize and repeat the sequence of lights and sounds. One more step every round.

modes.label: Mode
modes.classicHint: Repeat the sequence in the same order.
modes.reverseHint: Repeat the sequence starting from the end.

difficulty.label: Difficulty
difficulty.relaxedHint: 3 lives: if you slip, the sequence plays again.
difficulty.strictHint: No second chances: one mistake and it's over.

screens.keys: Keyboard: Q W A S or 1 2 3 4

board.label: Follow the Light: four colored buttons
